notes: Greens narrowly held power. Ozdemir (former federal agriculture minister) succeeded Kretschmann. CDU came within 0.6 points. AfD doubled its 2021 result to ~20%. SPD hit record low. Left Party entered parliament for first time. Sources: DW, OSW, GMF
CDU ended 35 years of continuous SPD rule in Rhineland-Palatinate. AfD gained over 10 percentage points. Major blow to SPD as junior coalition partner in federal government. Sources: DW, OSW, KAS
Historic election ending 16 years of Fidesz rule. TISZA won two-thirds supermajority (53% vs 39%). Magyar became PM in May 2026. EU unlocked 16.4B euros in frozen funds.

Early parliamentary election (8th since 2021). Progressive Bulgaria won 131/240 seats (outright majority). Former President Radev resigned Jan 2026 to form party. Triggered by collapse of GERB coalition after street protests. 24 parties contested, 4783 candidates.

incumbent: Various State CMs (Mamata Banerjee-WB, MK Stalin-TN, Pinarayi Vijayan-Kerala, Himanta Sarma-Assam)
notes: BJP won West Bengal for the first time in history, defeating Mamata Banerjee's TMC. Also won Bihar and Assam. Suvendu Adhikari led BJP's state campaign. Turnout 93.71% in West Bengal (highest ever). Mamata filed election petition in Calcutta High Court. Tamil Nadu elections also held in this cycle.
PAICV unseated ruling MpD after a decade in power. Francisco Carvalho set to become PM. Five parties competed for 72 National Assembly seats.
